headSubject: docs(ledger): session handoff after the long-run enforcement (NPDev 938eae10, ptrack 4feec61)
summary: 2026-11-24 night. The ONE full beta gate ran to completion as a TRACKED ptrack job (q9dcbe, 1 h 33 m, exit 1) and FAILED: candidateReady / releaseReady / officialReleaseEligible all false, 3 blockers (the first attempt, started from PowerShell, was invisible and died with its session). 23 of 25 steps passed (sample-matrix 41 min, docker-linux-parity via the CI proof 45490868311, report-schema-validation...). The 3 blockers: (1) ai-beta-gate, 30 of 31 scenarios passed -- custom-panel-procedure-mismatch had a silent Gradle build exit 1 (no error text, 16 s) and PASSES alone (11 min), so transient, cause not proven; (2) stale-report-check, an ORDER DEFECT in run-beta-release-evidence-orchestration.ps1: it runs in expanded-beta0-evidence (19:44) and measured three reports before this run regenerated them (49-51 h old; they are fresh and passed now), so it passes only if the previous full run was under 24 h earlier; (3) workspace-cleanliness: NPDevGenerator/.gradle (8 files) left by ai-beta-gate 28 s before the check. All recorded in REG-356 item 2a; evidence kept at D:\WorkSpace\NPDev\NPDev_General__OutsideRepo\beta-gate-2026-11-24-failure (17 files). Earlier this session (already pushed): CI on main fixed (REG-353 guard, 9620d12e); the long-run enforcement in NPDev (938eae10: require-digest.py blocks a long PowerShell run, run_digest.py refuses an untracked run, SessionStart lists ptrack jobs) and in the ptrack repo (4feec61: hook wraps Bash AND PowerShell, ptrack hook status, ptrack require); the new ptrack is installed here with matcher Bash|PowerShell. nextStep: FIRST `ptrack list`. Then the OWNER decides whether to run a second full beta gate (about 1.5 h). If yes, fix three things in scripts/quality BEFORE it, each with a test: (a) retry a scenario's generated-app Gradle build ONCE when it exits 1 with no error text (run-ai-beta-gate.ps1 / invoke-ai-beta-app-smoke.ps1); (b) evaluate stale-report-check after every report producer (move it out of expanded-beta0-evidence, or run it at the end of the orchestration); (c) clean rebuildable directories (NPDevGenerator/.gradle) before the workspace-cleanliness check. Then launch it TRACKED from the BASH tool (run_in_background true, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, python scripts/ai/run_digest.py -- pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/quality/run-beta-release-gate.ps1 -GenerateReports), clean tree, edit nothing meanwhile, confirm in `ptrack list`; a fresh CI Docker proof is needed if the latest green one is over 24 h old (gh workflow run ai-beta-gate.yml --ref main). On 2026-11-25 (not before): REG-356 kernel coverage floor 73.4185 -> 73.4139, read ledger/items/REG-356.yml first. Owner-side: the pilot with a real chat AI (PILOT.md) and sending the wave-2 request.
